description: A company by CIK or ticker, as on its Companies Daily page: tickers, exchanges, kind of filer, status, state of incorporation, city and state, SIC code, fiscal year end, last annual and quarterly report, Form D offering figures, XBRL totals, “What this means” notes (facts from filings, no judgement of the stock) and the classified filing history with links to the documents on EDGAR. No names of people.

cik.description: SEC CIK, leading zeros optional, e.g. "320193".

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. "AAPL" (used when cik is empty).

name: get_company
title: Company page from SEC filings
